description: This PHP class 'testsuite' provides CRUD operations, hierarchical management, export/import functionalities, custom field handling, keyword associations, and attachment management for test suite entities within the TestLink project. It supports creating, updating, deleting, copying, exporting test suites, and managing related data such as keywords and custom fields.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: This class manages test suite entities in TestLink, providing creation, updating, deletion, copying, hierarchical navigation, export/import operations, custom field and keyword management, and attachment handling within the testing framework.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test suite under a specified parent node with options for duplicate name handling.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the details of a test suite identified by its id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a test suite and its associated test cases, attachments, keywords, and custom fields.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves test suite info by its name, optionally filtered by parent_id.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Fetches detailed info for a test suite by its ID or IDs.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Returns data for all test suites in the database.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a test suite's info in a Smarty template for UI rendering.

methods.name: copy_to
methods.description: Copies a test suite recursively to another parent within the hierarchy, including options for copying keywords and attachments.

methods.name: get_subtree
methods.description: Retrieves a subtree of test suites and test cases from a specified node.

methods.name: get_testcases_deep
methods.description: Fetches all test cases within a test suite and its children, with varying detail levels.

methods.name: get_children_testcases
methods.description: Gets direct child test cases of a test suite with optional detailed info.

methods.name: delete_deep
methods.description: Deletes an entire test suite subtree, including test cases.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Returns keywords associated with a test suite.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Provides a map of keyword IDs to keyword strings for a test suite.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Associates a keyword with a test suite.

methods.name: addKeywords
methods.description: Adds multiple keywords to a test suite.

methods.name: deleteKeywords
methods.description: Removes specified keywords from a test suite.

methods.name: exportTestSuiteDataToXML
methods.description: Exports the structure and data of a test suite and optionally its test cases to an XML format.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_design
methods.description: Fetches custom fields linked to a test suite in design scope.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_execution
methods.description: Fetches custom fields linked to a test suite for execution context.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML input tables for custom fields in design or execution context.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Creates HTML tables showing custom field values for a test suite.

methods.name: copy_attachments
methods.description: Copies file attachments from one test suite to another.

methods.name: copy_keyword_assignment
methods.description: Copies keyword associations from source to target test suite using mappings.

methods.name: copy_cfields_values
methods.description: Copies custom field values from source to target test suite.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Returns direct child test suites with optional detailed info.

methods.name: get_branch
methods.description: Retrieves only test suites in a branch originating from a root test suite.

methods.name: createFromObject
methods.description: Creates a test suite from an object, with validation checks.

methods.name: checkNameExistence
methods.description: Verifies the uniqueness of a test suite name within a parent context.

methods.name: getFileUploadRelativeURL
methods.description: Provides URL for file upload related to a test suite.

methods.name: getDeleteAttachmentRelativeURL
methods.description: Provides URL for attachment deletion for a test suite.

methods.name: renderImageAttachments
methods.description: Embeds inline images from attachments into the test suite display.

methods.name: updateDetails
methods.description: Updates the detailed description of a test suite.

methods.name: inlineImageProcessing
methods.description: Processes inline images within test suite description content.

methods.name: buildDirectWebLink
methods.description: Constructs a web link to a test suite.

methods.name: getChildrenLatestTCVersion
methods.description: Retrieves latest versions of test cases directly under a test suite.

methods.name: getTSuitesFilteredByKWSet
methods.description: Retrieves test suites filtered by keyword sets with output customization.

methods.name: getFreeKeywords
methods.description: Fetches keywords not yet assigned to a specific test suite.

methods.name: getTestproject
methods.description: Retrieves the test project ID corresponding to a test suite.

methods.name: deleteKeywordByLinkID
methods.description: Removes a keyword linkage by its link ID.

methods.name: addKeywordsDeep
methods.description: Adds multiple keywords to a test suite and its subtrees.

methods.name: getKeywordsForTSSet
methods.description: Fetches keywords associated with a set of test suites.

methods.name: keywordIsLinked
methods.description: Checks if a specific keyword is linked to a test suite.
